configurations.//: RFC 0007 — launch Omniverse Kit (pyxis.editor) with the Pyxis Hydra
configurations.//2: delegate. Prebuilds the delegate (pyxis_hydra.dll, build/dev) and stages
configurations.//3: the Python omni.hydra.pyxis extension. cppvsdbg lets you set breakpoints
configurations.//4: in pyxis_hydra.dll once Kit loads it (Python __init__.py registers its
configurations.//5: plugInfo). The renderer menu lists 'Pyxis' (see RFC viewport caveat).

environment.//: RFC 0006: Pyxis delegate debug prints (PYXISDBG ...) — engine
environment.//2: borrow/release, persistEngine reads, SetRenderSetting, AOV writes.
environment.name: PYXIS_OMNI_DBG

configurations.//: RFC 0004 — debug the Pyxis Hydra delegate end-to-end WITHOUT Kit: the
configurations.//2: smoke harness drives a USD stage (mesh+material+light+camera) through
configurations.//3: the delegate via HdEngine and renders Pyxis into the host AOV. Fast
configurations.//4: iteration + full breakpoints in the delegate/engine. nv-usd 25.11 must
configurations.//5: precede vcpkg USD on PATH; PYXIS_OMNI_PYTHON_ROOT matches the CMake default.
configurations.name: Omniverse: HdEngine smoke (debug delegate)

environment.//: No usd-deps lib/usd here: the exe loads the usd_*.dll staged next to it and auto-discovers <bin>/usd; a second core plugin tree makes Plug lazy-load duplicate usd DLL copies that spin in their static initializers (see _tools/omniverse/run_smoke.ps1).
environment.name: PXR_PLUGINPATH_NAME
